Name: Shimea, Son of Uzza
Summary: Son of Uzza and father of Haggiah in Merari's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:30: Son of Uzza and father of Haggiah in Merari's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shimea stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
